description: Where CI runs and why: mode (external | in-process), declaration (external | in-process | auto) and its source (CI_EXECUTOR on the box, the estate-wide setting, or auto), runners configured / reachable / busy / slots, lastSeenAt, state (ok | degraded | unconfigured | in-process) and holdReason — the sentence every queued run shows when no runner can take it. In-process never runs while external runners are configured. Site admins (admin scope) also get per-runner rows and may pass `declare` (external | in-process | auto) to set the estate-wide setting, audited (the answer then carries `saved`). Same as GET/PUT /api/v2/ci/executor and /admin/runners.

declare.description: Site admins: set the estate-wide declaration to external, in-process or auto. Omit to read only.

name: gluecron_ci_executor
